The '''''Shemsher''''' was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] used by the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]]. It was present at a meeting between the leaders of both factions that was raided by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] who intended to capture the leaders of both factions only to kidnap their children instead.

She also attempted to sabotage the [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] while it was gathering [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]], but it was destroyed.
